name: Trend of new users and disabled users over time

search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows _sourceName=Security (4720 or 4725) ("EventCode = 4720;" or "EventCode = 4725;")
| timeslice by 1d 
| parse "EventCode = *;" as event_id nodrop | parse "Computer = \"*\";" as host nodrop | parse "ComputerName = \"*\";" as host nodrop | parse regex "Message = \"(?<msg_summary>[^\r]+?)\r" nodrop
| parse regex "Logfile = \"Security\";[\s\S]+?Account Name:\s+(?<src_user>[^\r]+?)\r[\s\S]+?Account Domain:\s+(?<src_domain>[^\r]+?)\r[\s\S]+?Account Name:\s+(?<dest_user>[^\r]+?)\r[\s\S]+?Account Domain:\s+(?<dest_domain>[^\r]+?)(?:\r|\";)" nodrop
| where event_id in ("4720","4725") 
| if (event_id="4720","New Users","Disabled Users") as type 
| count by _timeslice, type 
| sort by _timeslice asc 
| transpose row _timeslice column type
